office_does: A U.S. Representative writes and votes on federal law and spending, oversees the executive branch, and serves constituents for a two-year term; the 2nd District covers part of Snohomish County and all of Skagit, Whatcom, Island and San Juan counties.
race_blurb: Thirteen-term Democratic incumbent Rick Larsen, the lead Democrat on the Transportation & Infrastructure Committee, faces first-time Republican candidate Edwin H. Feller. The race contrasts Larsen's ICE-accountability, climate and abortion-rights positions with Feller's lower-tax, enforcement-first and sex-based Title IX platform.

candidates.summary: Thirteen-term incumbent and lead Democrat on the House Transportation & Infrastructure Committee, running on lowering costs, health care access, ICE accountability, abortion rights and infrastructure funding.
highlights: Will not vote for full-year DHS and ICE funding without oversight; voted against the Laken Riley Act [S2][S7]
Calls health care a right and backs universal coverage, with a record of ACA and Medicare cost measures [S2]
Voted for the Inflation Reduction Act and calls climate mitigation a top priority [S2][S8]
Supports the Women's Health Protection Act and cites a 100% voting record on choice [S2]
Voted for the 2024 Israel and Ukraine security supplementals [S9][S10]

taxes.basis: Supports scrapping the cap on income subject to Social Security taxes and voted against the 2025 One Big Beautiful Bill Act; no broader wealth-tax position stated.

spending.basis: Backs expanded child care, a $17 minimum wage, Medicare hearing benefits and infrastructure investment; voted for the Inflation Reduction Act.

safety.basis: On fentanyl pairs 'addiction is a disease' and prevention/recovery funding with strengthening law enforcement against traffickers.

climate.basis: Says mitigating climate change must be a top priority, supports clean energy, and voted for the Inflation Reduction Act.

experience.basis: Thirteenth-term incumbent and lead Democrat on Transportation & Infrastructure, facing a first-time candidate.

immigration.basis: Conditions DHS/ICE funding on oversight, wants ICE body cameras and visible ID, supports ending family detention and private detention, and voted against the Laken Riley Act.

healthcare.basis: States universal coverage as a goal but his record and proposals work through ACA and Medicare; no single-payer proposal.

social.basis: Supports suspending the filibuster to pass the Women's Health Protection Act, cites a 100% pro-choice record, endorsed by Planned Parenthood Action Fund and Stonewall Democrats.

tech.basis: Calls for 'strong guardrails' on data centers so their power and water costs are not passed to ratepayers.

defense.basis: Voted for the 2024 Israel and Ukraine security supplementals while opposing 'reckless foreign wars.'

candidates.summary: First-time Republican candidate and retired HVAC professional from Whatcom County, running on lower taxes, smaller government, enforcement-first immigration and public safety, energy deregulation and sex-based Title IX eligibility.
highlights: Blames the affordability crisis on high taxes and a government grown too large; supports balanced budgets [S1]
Proposes ending sanctuary policies, designating cartels as terrorist organizations and merit-based immigration [S2]
Would dismantle environmental mandates and repeal federal carbon taxes while expanding nuclear and hydro [S2]
Supports defining sex in Title IX as biological sex and a federal ban on irreversible medical procedures for minors [S2]

taxes.basis: Says the affordability crisis comes from taxes being too high and proposes repealing federal carbon taxes.

spending.basis: Supports balanced budgets, says government has grown too large, and lists fiscal responsibility as a priority.

safety.basis: Supports robust law enforcement and a federal Safe Streets mandate tying grants to local cooperation and ending sanctuary policies.

climate.basis: Proposes dismantling 'radical environmental mandates', repealing federal carbon taxes and expanding nuclear and hydro capacity.

experience.basis: Has never held public office and runs explicitly against a long-serving incumbent.

immigration.basis: Supports secure borders, ending sanctuary policies and a merit-based system that ends chain migration.

social.basis: Supports codifying Title IX 'sex' as biological sex in athletics and a federal ban on irreversible medical procedures for minors.
